hero.title: File:Poker Flat Research Range entrance.png
hero.credit: Flickr: VISIONS: Seeing the Aurora in a New Light
hero.description:
The entrance to the Poker Flat Research Range
The range is located 30 miles north of Fairbanks on the Steese Highway. Operated by the University of Alaska, Poker Flat Research Range is the only university-owned sounding rocket launching facility in the world. NASA personnel and scientists from across the nation have launched scientific sounding rockets from the facility since the late 1960s.
Credit: NASA/Goddard

gallery.title: File:M-TeX and MIST Experiments Launched from Alaska.jpg
gallery.description:
M-TeX and MIST Experiments Launched from Alaska.
Composite shot of all four rockets for the M-TeX and MIST experiments is made up of 30 second exposures. The rocket salvo began at 4:13 a.m. EST, Jan. 26, 2015, from the Poker Flat Research Range, Alaska.
